combo1.title: One-Card Lucina: June Pride on a Protected Stage
combo1.description: Pure Elfnote from a single Elfnote Lucina, with the Normal Summon left free. Regina climbs into the center zone, Tinia puts Elfnotes: Welcome Home on the field, and Elfnote Power Patron raises Regina to Level 9 for Elfnote June Pride. Both Synchro Materials refund themselves: Regina returns to the hand and Power Patron adds Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness. End board: June Pride in the center zone (it can't be destroyed by card effects while Welcome Home is up), Rhapsodia Set, and Regina in hand. Line 3 plays out the opponent's turn from here. Starting hand: Elfnote Lucina + 4 non-engine cards.

steps.text: Special Summon Elfnote Lucina from your hand to the center Main Monster Zone. This is its own summoning procedure, so it doesn't start a chain.
Activate effect: Elfnote Lucina adds 1 "Elfnote" monster from your Deck, except Lucina.
Add Elfnote Regina to your hand.
Activate effect: Elfnote Regina in your hand (Quick Effect).
Send Elfnote Lucina from the field to the GY as the cost. Regina accepts any other "Elfnote" card from your hand or face-up field.
Special Summon Elfnote Regina to the center Main Monster Zone that Lucina just left.
Activate effect: Regina arrived in the center zone, so it calls 1 "Elfnote" monster from your Deck.
Special Summon Elfnote Tinia from your Deck next to Regina.
Activate effect: Elfnote Tinia places 1 "Elfnote" Continuous Spell from your Deck.
Place Elfnotes: Welcome Home face-up. Placing a card isn't activating it, and its effects work at once: the monster in your center zone can't be destroyed by card effects.
Activate effect: Elfnotes: Welcome Home.
Send Elfnote Tinia (WATER) from the field to the GY as the cost.
Special Summon Elfnote Power Patron (FIRE, a different original Attribute) from your Deck in Defense Position. For the rest of this turn you can only summon Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck.
Activate effect: Elfnote Power Patron (Quick Effect) targets Regina in the center zone. Regina becomes Level 9.
Send Elfnote Power Patron to the GY as the Tuner.
Send Elfnote Regina (Level 9, a Spellcaster) to the GY as the non-Tuner.
Synchro Summon Elfnote June Pride (1 + 9 = Level 10) to the center Main Monster Zone, straight out of Power Patron's effect.
Activate effect: Elfnote Regina was sent to the GY as Synchro Material.
Regina returns to your hand. All three of its effects are used this turn, but they reset on your opponent's turn.
Activate effect: Elfnote Power Patron was sent to the GY as Synchro Material, so it adds 1 "Elfnote" card from your Deck.
Add Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness to your hand.
Set Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness. End your turn with June Pride in the center zone, Welcome Home face-up, Rhapsodia Set and Regina in hand.

combo2.title: Lucina + Theorealized Medius: Mediclius Waits in the Wings
combo2.description: The Beyond the Brave bridge. Elfnote Power Patron counts as a "Power Patron" card, so Theorealized Medius drops from the hand and adds Theorealize Past Lull, which brings Medius the Pure with no response to its summon. Medius calls Junoldo, which turns into Junora. Power Patron and Regina then make June Pride, and once Power Patron has left the field the Link Monsters are open: Purification Power Patron goes to the left Extra Monster Zone with Medius beside it. Welcome Home's Synchro-only lock is used last, because it ends with your turn. On your opponent's turn, Purification Power Patron Link Summons Mediclius into the left Extra Monster Zone, where its three arrows point at Junora, Fortuna and June Pride. Starting hand: Elfnote Lucina + Theorealized Medius + 3 non-engine cards.

Activate effect: Elfnote Lucina adds 1 "Elfnote" monster from your Deck.
Add Elfnote Regina to your hand.
Activate effect: Elfnote Regina in your hand (Quick Effect).

Special Summon Junora the Power Patron of Tuning from your Extra Deck. It is treated as a Synchro Summon, so Power Patron's lock allows it. Its arrival negate has nothing to hit on your first turn.
Activate effect: Junoldo was added to your Extra Deck face-up, so it adds 1 "Power Patron" or "Elfnote" card from your face-up Extra Deck or GY.
Add Elfnote Lucina from your GY to your hand.
Activate effect: Elfnote Power Patron (Quick Effect) targets Regina in the center zone. Regina becomes Level 9.
Send Elfnote Power Patron to the GY as the Tuner.
Send Elfnote Regina (Level 9) to the GY as the non-Tuner.

Regina returns to your hand.
Activate effect: Elfnote Power Patron was sent to the GY as Synchro Material.
Add Elfnotes: Welcome Home from your Deck to your hand. Power Patron has left the field, so its Synchro-only lock is gone.
Send Theorealized Medius to the GY as Link Material.
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as Link Material.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron (2 non-Link Monsters) to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effect: Purification Power Patron's arrival trigger. A "Power Patron" monster is in your GY: Elfnote Power Patron, and Theorealized Medius counts too.
Add Theorealize Overdrive from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Theorealize Overdrive from your hand, targeting Medius the Pure in your GY.
Special Summon Medius the Pure. Its arrival effect was already used this turn. You need a DARK Fairy next to Purification Power Patron for its Quick Effect.

Activate Elfnotes: Welcome Home from your hand.
Activate effect: Elfnotes: Welcome Home.

Place Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness face-up. End your turn: Junora, Fortuna and June Pride sit in the three zones the left Extra Monster Zone points down at.
Your opponent's Main Phase. Activate effect: Purification Power Patron (Quick Effect). You control Medius the Pure, a DARK Fairy.
Send Purification Power Patron to the GY as Link Material. A Link-2 counts as 2 materials.
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as Link Material.

Link Summon Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone. Its three arrows point at Junora, Fortuna and June Pride, so all three of its effects are on, including being unaffected by your opponent's activated effects.
Activate effect: Mediclius (Quick Effect, once per opponent's turn), when your opponent has committed their play.
Mediclius is banished together with every card your opponent controls. Junora, June Pride, Fortuna and Rhapsodia are still on your field.

combo3.title: The Rotation: Line 1's Board on Your Opponent's Turn
combo3.description: What the Line 1 board does once your opponent starts playing. Rhapsodia revives Tinia and negates a card while June Pride is still there to count as your Synchro Monster. Then June Pride returns to the Extra Deck for one Elfnote each from your GY and Deck. Regina lands in the center zone and, with its once-per-turn effects reset, calls one more. Tinia, Lucina and Fortuna then take turns switching into the center zone: each switch fires that monster's Quick Effect. That is four disruptions from a one-card combo. Needs a second Elfnote Lucina in the Deck (legal at 3 in the TCG). Start: June Pride in the center zone, Welcome Home face-up, Rhapsodia Set, Regina in hand.

steps.text: Your opponent's Main Phase. Flip Elfnotes: Rhapsodia of Madness face-up, then activate effect: Rhapsodia.
Send Elfnote Regina (WIND) from your hand to the GY as the cost, and target Elfnote Tinia (WATER, a different original Attribute) in your GY.
Special Summon Elfnote Tinia from your GY.
You control June Pride, a Synchro Monster, so Rhapsodia also negates the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls until the end of this turn.
Activate effect: Elfnote June Pride (Quick Effect). It's in the center zone during the Main Phase.
June Pride returns to the Extra Deck. You can summon it again later.
Special Summon Elfnote Regina from your GY to the center zone (June Pride's GY pick).
Special Summon Elfnote Fortuna from your Deck (June Pride's Deck pick, at the same moment). Your hand has no Elfnote left for the third pick.
Activate effect: Regina arrived in the center zone. It's a new turn, so its once-per-turn effects are ready again.
Special Summon a second Elfnote Lucina from your Deck.
Activate effect: Elfnote Tinia (Quick Effect) switches places with the monster in your center zone.
The switch, part 1: Regina leaves the center zone for Tinia's zone. Both move at the same moment.
The switch, part 2: Tinia takes the center zone.
Tinia banishes 1 random card from your opponent's hand face-up until the End Phase.
Activate effect: Elfnote Lucina (Quick Effect) switches places with Tinia.
The switch, part 1: Tinia leaves the center zone for Lucina's zone.
The switch, part 2: Lucina takes the center zone.
Lucina returns 1 Level 6 or lower monster your opponent controls to the hand.
Activate effect: Elfnote Fortuna (Quick Effect) switches places with Lucina.
The switch, part 1: Lucina leaves the center zone for Fortuna's zone.
The switch, part 2: Fortuna takes the center zone.
Fortuna returns 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field to the hand. Welcome Home keeps Fortuna, now in the center zone, safe from destruction by card effects.

combo4.title: Going Second: Junora's Negate into a 9900 ATK Swing
combo4.description: Going second into a set-up board, with no Elfnote Power Patron and no Welcome Home, so the Extra Deck stays open for Link Monsters. Regina calls Junoldo from the Deck, and Junoldo turns into Junora. Junora counts as Synchro Summoned, so it negates every face-up card your opponent controls. Medius the Pure calls Theorealized Medius for Purification Power Patron, and Overdrive brings Medius back for Mediclius. Medius's own GY effect fills the last zone, so Mediclius points at three monsters: it is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, and its Main Phase effect negates their monsters and halves their ATK. Skip June Pride here: in the center zone it stops your side monsters from attacking. Starting hand: Elfnote Lucina + Medius the Pure + 3 non-engine cards.

Activate effect: Elfnote Lucina adds 1 "Elfnote" monster from your Deck.

Activate effect: Medius the Pure's arrival trigger calls 1 "Power Patron" monster from your Deck.

Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone.

Special Summon Medius the Pure.

Send Medius the Pure to the GY as Link Material.
Link Summon Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone. Its arrows point at your three leftmost Main Monster Zones: Junora and Regina are there already.

Shuffle Elfnote Lucina from your hand into the Deck.
Special Summon Medius the Pure to your leftmost Main Monster Zone. It is banished when it leaves the field. Mediclius now points at three monsters.
Activate effect: Mediclius negates the effects of every face-up monster your opponent currently controls and halves their ATK until the end of this turn.

Battle Phase: Mediclius (3000), Junora (3100), Regina (2000) and Medius (1800) make 9900 ATK. Into an empty field that's game; into blockers, their ATK is halved and Mediclius ignores your opponent's activated effects.
